title: Blinded Mechanism Boundary and Subsumption Test
question: After removing field names and presentation cues, can qualified independent reviewers identify at least one operational Framework Engineering mechanism that is not losslessly supplied by a credible adjacent method or generic structured baseline?
claim_under_test: At least one candidate Framework Engineering mechanism cannot be losslessly mapped to the strongest adjacent-method implementation and yields a distinct, testable prediction.
objective: Test mechanism-level subsumption against frozen primary-source comparators.
evaluator_role: independent research director and adversarial methodologist
assumptions: Qualified independent reviewers are available for Stage B
procedure: Blind cards and run recognition pretest.
replication_plan: Three independent reviewers, cap of one per model family, at least one human with method/systems expertise.
falsification_conditions: Every candidate FE mechanism can be mapped to one or more adjacent or generic practices without material loss.
inconclusive_conditions: Blinding fails, coverage is insufficient, or reviewer agreement is under threshold.
stopping_conditions: Stop if any material comparator lacks minimum source coverage or if key isolation fails.
synthesis_policy: No confidence update from model agreement alone. Synthesis may refine protocol but cannot accept/reject FEH-001.
adjudication_policy: Resolve factual disputes through cited repository evidence; do not use majority vote.
privacy_and_security: Only declared public repository inputs may be sent to an external provider.
cost_and_resource_limits: Stage B is gated; manual import is provider-neutral.
